execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Booking" (
  "agreedPrice" numeric,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organizerMessage" text,
  "providerMessage" text,
  "providerServiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_status_check_fcf883e8" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Conversation" (
  "bookingId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Event" (
  "budget" numeric NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "eventDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "eventType" text NOT NULL,
  "guestCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text NOT NULL,
  "organizerId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Event_status_check_072898d6" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EventRequiredService" (
  "budget" numeric,
  "categoryId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Message" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "conversationId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isRead" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "senderId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ProviderAvailability" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endDateTime" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "providerId" text NOT NULL,
  "startDateTime" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ProviderAvailability_status_check_6b414904" CHECK ("status" IN ('AVAILABLE', 'UNAVAILABLE', 'BOOKED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ProviderProfile" (
  "businessName" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "verified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "websiteUrl" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ProviderService" (
  "categoryId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric NOT NULL,
  "pricingType" text NOT NULL,
  "providerId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ProviderService_pricingType_check_5e27a7a8" CHECK ("pricingType" IN ('FIXED', 'PER_HOUR', 'PER_GUEST', 'CUSTOM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Review" (
  "bookingId" text NOT NULL,
  "comment" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organizerId" text NOT NULL,
  "providerId" text NOT NULL,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ServiceCategory" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "iconUrl" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "avatarUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "User_role_check_02e3aac1" CHECK ("role" IN ('ORGANIZER', 'PROVIDER', 'ADMIN'))
)
